description: The Stock Market record for one colored Pokemon form: reference price of a level 5 copy in GC coins (fictional in-game currency), 30 day change, recorded sales, copies in the game, color battle bonus, promo cost and dates. A form with no counted sale has no reference price.

name.description: The colored form name, with or without the space: ShadowShellder or Shadow Shellder. Colors: Shadow, Haunted, Frost, Glitter, Demon, Golden, Eternal, Baby.
